sample.description:
Scheduled Road Work on Lox Rd Both Directions from SR-7 Southbound to Parkside Dr. All lanes closed.
Comments: The Florida Department of Transportation has shared that Lox Road is scheduled to close from Parkside Drive to U.S. 441 in January 12, 2026, for roundabout construction. This will be a full closure, and resident access will be maintained. As part of the Loxahatchee Road Improvements Project, crews will begin with phased roadway improvements on Loxahatchee Road between Parkside Drive and U.S. 441/S.R. 7, including the construction of the roundabout at Parkside Drive, starting Jan. 12, 2026. To ensure community and public safety, Loxahatchee Road between Parkside Drive and U.S. 441/S.R. 7 will be closed and traffic will be detoured through Fall of 2026. Business and residential access (Local Access) will be maintained at all times throughout construction. To ensure overall safety, FDOT urges motorists to use precaution as they traverse through the area.

sample.description:
Bridge Construction on US-71 from Natchitoches Winn Parish Line (MM 126) to Nordie Harrison Rd (MM 122) . Starting 9/5/2024 12:00 AM
Comments: The Louisiana Department of Transportation and Development (DOTD), advises the public that on Thursday, September 5, 2024 construction will begin on US 71 in Winn & Natchitoches Parishes. This work will begin at the bridge over Little Natchez Bayou on US 71 and proceeded north for 1.184 Miles to include bridges over Saline Bayou and Chevreuille Bayou. The intent of this project to replace 3 bridges on US 71 near the Natchitoches/Winn Parish line. The work will include clearing and grubbing, removal of existing bridges, drainage structures, milling asphalt concrete, pavement patching, class II base course, lime treatment, one concrete slab span bridge, two concrete girder span bridges , and other related work. Permit/Detour section Thru traffic will be maintained at all times with oversize and emergency vehicles allowed passage. There will be no detour routes for this project.
